title: Add keyed historical exchange lookup and rebuildable ledger views
outcome: Provide exact receipt-first historical lookup over the existing canonical ledger, maintained atomic keyed projections, repair and verified projection cutover fixtures.
acceptance: Keyed rebuildable operation/head views resolve a complete immutable exchange intent and return its original canonical completed outcome before payload or current-planning reads, including after later exchanges and local movement; collisions and inconsistent provenance refuse without full-scan fallback.

Existing canonical writers maintain the derived views in the same transaction. One transition reducer supports chain validation, projection derivation, writer updates and doctor comparison; historical records, fingerprints, receipts, IDs and links retain original bytes and meaning.

All new SQL structures are explicitly rebuildable projections. Deterministic repair derives them from validated historical canonical chains and refuses incomplete/corrupt history atomically; no durable SQL reshape or historical-record conversion.

Actual old/new binary fixtures prove new-build no-write refusal before repair, unchanged historical canonical bytes and receipts after repair, and old-build refusal after repair. READY specifies every-live-store projection repair and coordinated cutover before new writes.

Library tests discriminate exact intent mismatch, original receipt replay after movement, bounded reads as unrelated history grows, missing/stale projection refusal, atomic canonical/view rollback and failed repair. Typed delta application and ordinary sync wiring remain required separate parent work.
